text: Julian Hargrove plans a Node.js and TypeScript indexer that listens for every Staked, Withdrawn, and RewardsClaimed event EmberStake emits.
On top of that, a REST API exposes staking balances and protocol stats, so the frontend never has to query the chain directly.
Deployment plans in two stages -- EmberStake goes to the Base Sepolia testnet first, for a full end-to-end rehearsal.
Mainnet only happens after a checklist is cleared, and that checklist explicitly requires the security audit to have already passed.
Next: writing the real Solidity for staking, as $EMBER integration finally becomes working code.
